answer: An agent exchange can sell each indivisible service slot by a sealed first-price auction: the highest bid wins and pays its own bid, with no rebates or account bonuses. A sable trader gains nothing by submitting a plume of losing aliases; they cannot reduce the price of its winning bid. Even for a coveted opal appraisal slot, extra names create no extra allocation. Unlike rebate schemes, adding fake losers never generates a refund to finance the attack.
